tasks.label: fix-admin-encoding
tasks.command: $files = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter 'admin*.html' -File; foreach ($f in $files) { $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252).GetBytes($raw); $fixed = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f.FullName, $fixed, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); } ; Write-Output "fixed $($files.Count) files"

tasks.label: inspect-admin-braces
tasks.command: $i=1; Get-Content js/admin.js | ForEach-Object { if ($i -ge 840 -and $i -le 1080) { '{0,5}: {1}' -f $i, $_ }; $i++ }

tasks.label: inspect-admin-prelude
tasks.command: $i=1; Get-Content js/admin.js | ForEach-Object { if ($i -ge 740 -and $i -le 840) { '{0,5}: {1}' -f $i, $_ }; $i++ }

tasks.label: bump-local-script-versions
tasks.command: $adminFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter 'admin*.html' -File; foreach($f in $adminFiles){ $c = Get-Content -Raw $f.FullName; $c = $c -replace 'js/admin\.js\?v=20260726-6','js/admin.js?v=20260726-7'; Set-Content -Path $f.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8; }; $index='index.html'; $ci = Get-Content -Raw $index; $ci = $ci -replace 'js/app\.js\?v=20260726-10','js/app.js?v=20260726-11'; Set-Content -Path $index -Value $ci -Encoding utf8; Write-Output 'version bump done';

tasks.label: fix-two-admin-encodings
tasks.command: $targets = @('admin-draw-results.html','admin-draw-schedule.html'); foreach($name in $targets){ $full = Join-Path (Get-Location) $name; $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252).GetBytes($raw); $fixed = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, $fixed, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); }; Write-Output 'fixed two files';

tasks.label: repair-all-admin-encoding-again
tasks.command: $files = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter 'admin*.html' -File; foreach ($f in $files) { $raw = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252).GetBytes($raw); $fixed = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($f.FullName, $fixed, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); } ; Write-Output "repaired $($files.Count) admin files"

tasks.label: bump-admin-version-v9
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter 'admin*.html' -File | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; $c = $c -replace 'js/admin\.js\?v=20260726-8','js/admin.js?v=20260726-9'; Set-Content -Path $_.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8; }; Write-Output 'admin version now v9';

tasks.label: admin-menu-cuadro-no-idiomas
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter 'admin*.html' -File | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; $c = $c.Replace('Resultados','Cuadro'); $c = [regex]::Replace($c,'\r?\n\s*Idiomas',''); Set-Content -Path $_.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8 }; Write-Output 'admin menu updated';

tasks.label: admin-menu-add-cruces
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter 'admin*.html' -File | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; $old = 'Cuadro`r`n`r`n Resultados'; $new = 'Cuadro`r`n`r`n Cruces`r`n`r`n Resultados'; $c = $c.Replace($old, $new); Set-Content -Path $_.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8 }; Write-Output 'inserted Cruces menu in admin pages';

tasks.label: copy-admin-draw-builder
tasks.command: Copy-Item "admin-draw-schedule.html" "admin-draw-builder.html" -Force; Write-Output "copied"

tasks.label: insert-cruces-menu-regex
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter 'admin*.html' -File | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; $c = [regex]::Replace($c,'Cuadro\s*Resultados','Cuadro`r`n`r`n Cruces`r`n`r`n Resultados'); Set-Content -Path $_.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8 }; Write-Output 'cruces inserted regex';

tasks.label: insert-cruces-after-cuadro
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter 'admin*.html' -File | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName; if ($c -notmatch 'draw-builder-panel') { $c = [regex]::Replace($c,'Cuadro','Cuadro`r`n`r`n Cruces',1); Set-Content -Path $_.FullName -Value $c -Encoding utf8 } }; Write-Output 'cruces inserted after cuadro';

tasks.label: bump-admin-js-v10

tasks.label: check-git-availability
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; where.exe git; if (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { winget --version } else { Write-Output 'winget-not-found' }

tasks.label: install-git-winget
tasks.command: winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --silent

tasks.label: locate-git-and-status
tasks.command: $git='C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $git)) { $git='C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe' }; if (!(Test-Path $git)) { Write-Error 'git.exe not found after install'; exit 1 }; & $git --version; & $git status --short

tasks.label: check-gh-cli
tasks.command: $gh=(Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($gh) { gh --version } else { Write-Output 'gh-not-found' }

tasks.label: create-safe-backup-copy
tasks.command: $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $src = '..\psavalencia-main'; $dst = "..\psavalencia-main-backup-$stamp"; Copy-Item -Path $src -Destination $dst -Recurse -Force; Write-Output "BACKUP_CREATED $dst"

tasks.label: create-safe-backup-copy-2
tasks.command: $dst = ('..\\psavalencia-main-backup-' + (Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss)); Copy-Item -Path . -Destination $dst -Recurse -Force; Write-Output "BACKUP_CREATED $dst"

tasks.label: init-new-local-repo
tasks.command: $git='C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $git)) { $git='C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe' }; & $git init -b main; $name = (& $git config --global user.name); $email = (& $git config --global user.email); if (-not $name) { & $git config user.name 'PSA Valencia'; }; if (-not $email) { & $git config user.email 'noreply@local.dev'; }; & $git add -A; & $git commit -m 'chore: initial safe migration snapshot'; & $git status --short; & $git branch --show-current
